caveat: Transcribed from the paper, not measured here -- the only numbers in this folder that are. Their pipeline differs from ours in ways no protocol match can remove: SMPL meshes resampled to 30 Hz against our 60 Hz OpenSim joint kinematics and torques, and an AdamW head with a tuned learning rate, epoch budget and loss type against our convex L-BFGS. Read these as the band a purpose-built motion encoder reaches, not as a target we are trying to hit exactly.
